python.title: Python Programming
python.desc: Master Python from scratch: data types, control flow, functions, dictionaries, and file handling. Highly requested in industry.

modules.title: Module I: Python Basics & Strings
modules.desc: History, Identifiers, Operators. String creation, slicing, formatting, and built-in functions.

modules.title: Module II: Control Flow & Functions
modules.desc: If-else, loops, break/continue. Lambda functions, Scope, Command line arguments.

modules.title: Module III: Data Structures
modules.desc: Mutable/Immutable: Lists, Tuples, Dictionaries. Introduction to Numpy arrays.

modules.title: Module IV: File Handling & Exceptions
modules.desc: Reading/Writing Text, CSV, JSON. Exception hierarchy. Basics of Matplotlib plotting.

dbms.title: DBMS Using PL/SQL
dbms.desc: Understand architecture, ER modelling, Normalization, Relational Algebra and practically apply SQL operations.

modules.title: Module I: Intro & Architecture
modules.desc: Concept models, schema, physical and logical data models. Role of DBA.

modules.title: Module II: ER & EER Models
modules.desc: ER components. Superclass/subclass, Specialization, Aggregation.

modules.title: Module III: Normalization Process
modules.desc: First, Second, Third, BCNF Normal forms. Transforming ER models.

modules.title: Module IV: SQL Implementation
modules.desc: Relational algebra, CREATE, INSERT, SELECT queries, Aggregate functions.

modules.title: Module V: File Organization
modules.desc: Storage, Hashing, B-Trees, Secondary storage basics.

daa.title: Design & Analysis of Algorithms
daa.desc: Core CS fundamentals: Time complexities, Divide & Conquer, Greedy strategies, and Dynamic programming approaches.

modules.title: Module I: Time Complexity & Sorting
modules.desc: Asymptotic notations. Bubble, Insertion, Selection sorts.

modules.title: Module II: Divide & Conquer
modules.desc: Binary search, Merge sort, Quick sort. Strassen's multiplication.

modules.title: Module III: Greedy Techniques
modules.desc: Knapsack, Kruskal's, Prim's algorithms, Dijkstra's algorithm.

modules.title: Module IV: Dynamic Programming
modules.desc: Fibonacci, 0/1 Knapsack, Floyd-Warshall path algorithms.

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence
ai.desc: Intelligent agents, uninformed and informed search, logic, and basics of machine learning (Python mapped).

modules.title: Module I: Intro & Intelligent Agents
modules.desc: AI concepts, rationality, agent architecture.

modules.title: Module II: Search Algorithms
modules.desc: BFS, DFS, A* Search. Minimax & Alpha-Beta pruning.

modules.title: Module III: Knowledge Representation
modules.desc: Propositional logic, predicate logic, Fuzzy logic sets.

modules.title: Module IV: Emerging tech & ML
modules.desc: Robotics, Computer vision, Neural network fundamentals.

dccn.title: Computer Networks
dccn.desc: Understanding how the internet works, TCP/IP vs OSI model, top-to-bottom transmission architecture.
dccn.notesName: GFG CN Hub & Standard Textbook links

modules.title: Module I: Networks & Topologies
modules.desc: Bus, Star, Ring configurations. Basic standardizations.

modules.title: Module II: Transmission Media
modules.desc: Cables, Fiber optics, digital and analog transition logic.

modules.title: Module III: Switching Models
modules.desc: Packet switching, circuit switching, message protocols.

modules.title: Module IV: Reference Models & Routing
modules.desc: OSI Layers breakdown. Basic IP architecture.

se.title: Software Engineering
se.desc: Complete guide to software development lifecycles (SDLC), requirement gathering, diagramming, and QA testing.

modules.title: Module I: SDLC Models
modules.desc: Waterfall, Agile, Spiral. Evolving nature of code.

modules.title: Module II: Requirements Analysis
modules.desc: Functional requirements, preparing standard SRS documents.

modules.title: Module III: Designing architectures
modules.desc: Class diagrams, sequence models, mapping components.

modules.title: Module IV: Testing Paradigms
modules.desc: Black box, white box testing, bug fixing logic.

cg.title: Computer Graphics
cg.desc: Mathematical basis of drawing on screens. CRT, raster scanning, Bresenham line algorithms, scaling & translations.

modules.title: Module I: Visual Systems
modules.desc: Pixels, CRT, LCD displays architecture.

modules.title: Module II: Line & Curve algorithms
modules.desc: DDA, Bresenham Line and circle formulas.

modules.title: Module III: 2D & 3D Geometry Transform
modules.desc: Matrix transformations (Scale, rotate, translate).

ot.title: Optimization Technique
ot.desc: Operations research mathematically finding the best scheduling, planning, or mapping outcomes (LPP & Transportation).

modules.title: Module I: LPP Graph Methods
modules.desc: Creating LPP bounds, shading intersection spaces.

modules.title: Module II: The Simplex Algorithm
modules.desc: Handling multiple constraints via pivoting arrays.

modules.title: Module III: Transport Optimizing
modules.desc: Vogel's cost technique, northwest corner routing methods.

c_programming.title: Programming in C
c_programming.desc: A beginner roadmap through C syntax, control flow, functions, arrays, pointers, structures, and file handling. Generic outline; confirm topics with your university syllabus.

modules.title: Module I: C Basics and Data Types
modules.desc: Program structure, compiling, variables, constants, operators, formatted input/output, and type conversion.

modules.title: Module II: Decisions, Loops, and Functions
modules.desc: Conditional statements, iteration, function prototypes, arguments, return values, scope, and recursion.

modules.title: Module III: Arrays, Strings, and Pointers
modules.desc: One- and two-dimensional arrays, string handling, pointer arithmetic, and the relationship between arrays and pointers.

modules.title: Module IV: Structures and Files
modules.desc: Structures, unions, enumerations, dynamic memory basics, and text-file input/output.

computer_fundamentals.title: Computer Fundamentals
computer_fundamentals.desc: An introduction to computer systems, data representation, operating systems, networks, and safe digital practices. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.
computer_fundamentals.notesName: Cisco Networking Academy: Computer Hardware Basics

modules.title: Module I: Computer Systems and Hardware
modules.desc: Computer generations and types, CPU components, input/output devices, ports, and peripheral devices.

modules.title: Module II: Data Representation and Memory
modules.desc: Binary, decimal, and hexadecimal numbers; character coding; units of storage; primary and secondary memory.

modules.title: Module III: Software and Operating Systems
modules.desc: System and application software, operating-system responsibilities, files, folders, and common utilities.

modules.title: Module IV: Networks, Internet, and Digital Safety
modules.desc: Network basics, web services, cloud storage, passwords, privacy, malware awareness, and safe browsing.

mathematics_i.title: Mathematics for Computing I
mathematics_i.desc: A computing-oriented mathematics roadmap covering logic, sets, relations, counting, and probability. Generic discrete-mathematics outline; confirm the actual topics with your university.

videos.title: Discrete Mathematics for Computer Science playlist search

modules.title: Module I: Propositional Logic and Proofs
modules.desc: Statements, logical connectives, truth tables, implications, predicates, and introductory proof techniques.

modules.title: Module II: Sets, Relations, and Functions
modules.desc: Set operations, Cartesian products, relation properties, equivalence relations, partial orders, and function types.

modules.title: Module III: Counting and Combinatorics
modules.desc: Sum and product rules, permutations, combinations, binomial coefficients, and the pigeonhole principle.

modules.title: Module IV: Probability and Discrete Structures
modules.desc: Basic probability, conditional probability, simple recurrences, graphs, and trees where included by the syllabus.

communication_skills.title: Communication Skills
communication_skills.desc: Practice clear academic and professional communication through writing, presentations, listening, and teamwork. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.

modules.title: Module I: Grammar and Clear Expression
modules.desc: Sentence structure, parts of speech, common errors, vocabulary, tone, and concise paragraph writing.

modules.title: Module II: Academic and Professional Writing
modules.desc: Emails, applications, reports, summaries, proofreading, audience, and purpose.

modules.title: Module III: Listening, Speaking, and Presentations
modules.desc: Active listening, group discussion, public speaking, presentation structure, and visual aids.

modules.title: Module IV: Technical Communication and Teamwork
modules.desc: Explaining technical ideas, meeting etiquette, collaboration, interview basics, and constructive feedback.

data_structures.title: Data Structures
data_structures.desc: A practical progression from complexity and linear structures to trees, graphs, hashing, and sorting. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.

videos.title: Complete C++ Data Structures and Algorithms

modules.title: Module I: Algorithm Analysis and Arrays
modules.desc: Abstract data types, time and space complexity, asymptotic notation, arrays, and searching.

modules.title: Module II: Linked Lists, Stacks, and Queues
modules.desc: Singly and doubly linked lists, stack operations and applications, queues, and circular queues.

modules.title: Module III: Trees and Heaps
modules.desc: Tree terminology, binary trees, traversals, binary search trees, balanced-tree concepts, and heaps.

modules.title: Module IV: Graphs, Hashing, and Sorting
modules.desc: Graph representations and traversals, hash tables, collision handling, and common sorting algorithms.

cpp.title: Object-Oriented Programming with C++
cpp.desc: Learn C++ fundamentals and object-oriented programming, then apply classes, inheritance, templates, and the standard library. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.

videos.title: C++ Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course

modules.title: Module I: C++ Basics and Control Flow
modules.desc: Program structure, types, operators, input/output, conditions, loops, and basic functions.

modules.title: Module II: Functions, Classes, and Objects
modules.desc: Function overloading, constructors, access control, encapsulation, and object lifetime.

modules.title: Module III: Inheritance and Polymorphism
modules.desc: Inheritance, overriding, virtual functions, abstract classes, and composition.

modules.title: Module IV: Templates, Exceptions, and STL
modules.desc: Exception handling, function and class templates, strings, containers, iterators, and algorithms.

digital_logic.title: Digital Logic and Computer Organization
digital_logic.desc: A foundation in number systems, Boolean logic, digital circuits, and sequential components. Generic outline; confirm the required depth with your university syllabus.

modules.title: Module I: Number Systems and Codes
modules.desc: Binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal conversion; signed numbers; complements; and common codes.

modules.title: Module II: Boolean Algebra and Logic Gates
modules.desc: Boolean laws, truth tables, logic gates, canonical forms, and simplification using Karnaugh maps.

modules.title: Module III: Combinational Circuits
modules.desc: Adders, subtractors, multiplexers, decoders, encoders, and basic circuit design.

modules.title: Module IV: Sequential Logic and Memory
modules.desc: Latches, flip-flops, registers, counters, finite-state concepts, and introductory memory organization.

accounting.title: Financial Accounting
accounting.desc: An introductory accounting sequence from transactions and ledgers to financial statements and analysis. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.

modules.title: Module I: Accounting Concepts and the Equation
modules.desc: Purpose of accounting, users, principles, the accounting equation, and recording business transactions.

modules.title: Module II: Journals, Ledgers, and Trial Balance
modules.desc: Double-entry rules, journalizing, posting to ledger accounts, and preparing a trial balance.

modules.title: Module III: Adjustments and Financial Statements
modules.desc: Accruals, deferrals, depreciation basics, adjusting entries, and preparation of core statements.

modules.title: Module IV: Cash Flow and Financial Analysis
modules.desc: Cash-flow statement concepts, liquidity and profitability ratios, and introductory statement analysis.

java.title: Java Programming
java.desc: A Java roadmap covering programming fundamentals, object-oriented design, collections, exceptions, and small applications. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.

videos.title: Java Tutorials for Beginners in Hindi

modules.title: Module I: Java Syntax and Control Flow
modules.desc: JDK and JVM basics, variables, types, operators, input/output, conditions, loops, and methods.

modules.title: Module II: Classes and Object-Oriented Design
modules.desc: Classes, objects, constructors, encapsulation, inheritance, interfaces, and polymorphism.

modules.title: Module III: Exceptions and Collections
modules.desc: Exception handling, generic types, lists, sets, maps, iteration, and collection use cases.

modules.title: Module IV: Files, Testing, and Applications
modules.desc: File input/output, packages, basic unit testing, debugging, and building a small console application.

web_technology.title: Web Technologies
web_technology.desc: Build a web foundation with semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, browser APIs, and accessible responsive pages. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.

videos.title: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Projects, and Git

modules.title: Module I: HTML and Semantic Structure
modules.desc: Document structure, semantic elements, links, lists, tables, forms, and accessible labels.

modules.title: Module II: CSS and Responsive Design
modules.desc: Selectors, box model, typography, Flexbox, Grid, media queries, and responsive layouts.

modules.title: Module III: JavaScript and the DOM
modules.desc: Variables, functions, arrays, events, DOM selection and updates, validation, and browser debugging.

modules.title: Module IV: Web Applications and Accessibility
modules.desc: HTTP basics, client/server roles, form handling, accessibility checks, and deploying a static site.

computer_architecture.title: Computer Architecture
computer_architecture.desc: Study how instructions execute, how a processor is organized, and how memory and I/O systems affect performance. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.

modules.title: Module I: Data Representation and Instruction Sets
modules.desc: Integer and floating-point representation, machine instructions, addressing modes, and assembly-language concepts.

modules.title: Module II: Processor Datapath and Control
modules.desc: Register transfers, ALU operations, instruction cycles, datapath components, and control-unit organization.

modules.title: Module III: Pipelining and Performance
modules.desc: Instruction pipelines, hazards, interrupts, performance metrics, and introductory parallelism.

modules.title: Module IV: Memory Hierarchy and I/O
modules.desc: Cache principles, main and secondary memory, buses, I/O techniques, and storage systems.

software_testing.title: Software Testing and Quality Assurance
software_testing.desc: A practical software quality roadmap spanning test design, levels, automation, defects, and release readiness. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.
software_testing.notesName: ISTQB CTFL v4.0 syllabus and materials

modules.title: Module I: Testing Fundamentals and Lifecycle
modules.desc: Testing objectives, principles, verification and validation, test levels, and the software development lifecycle.

modules.title: Module II: Test Design Techniques
modules.desc: Equivalence partitioning, boundary values, decision tables, state transitions, and experience-based testing.

modules.title: Module III: Test Execution and Automation
modules.desc: Test planning, test cases, manual execution, regression, automation concepts, and test reporting.

modules.title: Module IV: Defects and Quality Assurance
modules.desc: Defect lifecycle, severity and priority, root-cause analysis, reviews, metrics, and release criteria.

cloud_computing.title: Cloud Computing
cloud_computing.desc: An introduction to cloud service models, architecture, storage, deployment, security, and cost awareness. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.

modules.title: Module I: Cloud Concepts and Service Models
modules.desc: Cloud characteristics, public/private/hybrid deployments, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and virtualization.

modules.title: Module II: Cloud Architecture and Storage
modules.desc: Regions and availability zones, compute and networking basics, object storage, databases, and scalability.

modules.title: Module III: Containers and Serverless
modules.desc: Containers, orchestration concepts, event-driven computing, serverless functions, and deployment workflows.

modules.title: Module IV: Cloud Security, Cost, and Monitoring
modules.desc: Identity and access, shared responsibility, backup, monitoring, reliability, and introductory cost management.

cyber_security.title: Cyber Security
cyber_security.desc: Learn security principles, common threats, defensive controls, and responsible security practice. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.

modules.title: Module I: Security Principles and Threats
modules.desc: Confidentiality, integrity, availability, assets, threat modelling, social engineering, and common malware.

modules.title: Module II: Network and Web Security
modules.desc: Network attack surfaces, secure communication, authentication risks, web vulnerabilities, and OWASP concepts.

modules.title: Module III: Cryptography and Defensive Controls
modules.desc: Encryption and hashing concepts, access control, firewalls, secure configuration, and backups.

modules.title: Module IV: Ethical Testing and Incident Response
modules.desc: Authorization and scope, responsible disclosure, basic incident handling, evidence care, and recovery.

data_mining.title: Data Mining
data_mining.desc: Explore data preparation, classification, clustering, association analysis, and evaluation. Generic outline; confirm with your university syllabus.
data_mining.mockName: UCI Machine Learning Repository practice datasets

modules.title: Module I: Data Preparation and Exploration
modules.desc: Data types, cleaning, integration, transformation, feature selection, and exploratory analysis.

modules.title: Module II: Classification and Prediction
modules.desc: Training and test sets, decision trees, classification basics, prediction, and overfitting.

modules.title: Module III: Clustering and Association
modules.desc: Similarity measures, k-means concepts, hierarchical clustering, frequent itemsets, and association rules.

modules.title: Module IV: Evaluation and Visualization
modules.desc: Confusion matrices, precision and recall, validation, interpreting patterns, and communicating results.

project_work.title: Major Project
project_work.desc: A milestone-based guide for planning, building, testing, documenting, and presenting a BCA capstone. Adapt it to your department's project rubric.

modules.title: Module I: Problem Selection and Requirements
modules.desc: Define a real problem, identify users, assess feasibility, gather requirements, and write measurable objectives.

modules.title: Module II: System Design and Planning
modules.desc: Plan milestones, model workflows and data, design the interface, choose tools, and track risks.

modules.title: Module III: Implementation and Testing
modules.desc: Build in small increments, use version control, test core flows, fix defects, and review accessibility and security.

modules.title: Module IV: Deployment, Report, and Viva
modules.desc: Deploy a working release, write setup and user documentation, prepare a demonstration, and explain design decisions.
